OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
       WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE
       TIME ALLOWED:
       READING TIME: 5 MINUTES
       WRITING TIME: 40 MINUTES
Read the case notes and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:

Patient: Gracy Williams (Mrs)
DOB: 10/09/1950
Ht: 162cm Wt:85kg BMI: 32.44(20/04/2018)
Social History: not working, house wife
Married, 2 children
Nonsmoker
Nondrinker
Substance Intake: Nil
Allergies: penicillin drugs
FHx: Mother-Diabetes; Father: Hypertension
Maternal grandmother- unknown
Maternal grandfather-died of rectal cancer
Paternal grandmother-died of heart attack, 65
Paternal grandfather-95yrs, diabetes
PMHx: Childhood measles
1970 chicken pox
1990 RTA
2002 typhoid fever
 
2013 Fibroid on uterus, Hysterectomy done
2016 viral fever
20/04/2018
Subjective: complaints of severe pain, numbness, tingling sensation in
bilateral legs especially while walking, back pain, weakness – 2 weeks,
Analgesics not helpful.
Objective: Highly distressed, Neurologic Examination done: slow deep
tendon reflexes, gait test: walks slowly due to pain, LaSegue test - abnormal,
vital signs : T- 38.2 °C ,P – 100 bpm & B.P -140/80
MRI findings: Focal left L5/S1 protrusion resulting in compression effect on
the descending left S1 nerve root.
Rx ibuprofen (200 mg), volateran gel for pain.
Review after 48 hours or earlier depending on the severity of the condition.
23/04/2018
patient condition not improved. pain increased. plan for surgery, discussed
with the pt regarding surgery.

Writing task:
Using the information in the case notes, write a letter of referral for further
assessment and management of this patient to the orthopedic surgeon, Dr.
Patrick John, Surgical Outpatient Clinic, Royal Perth hospital.
In your answer:

        Expand the relevant case notes into complete sentences
        Do not use note form
        The body of the letter should not be more than 200 words
        Use correct letter format

Custom
Sentence Medical History
